subject: chemistry

concepts.title: Average Atomic Mass
concepts.definition: The weighted mean of the masses of all naturally occurring isotopes of an element, calculated based on their relative abundance.
concepts.key_idea: Isotopes contribute to the total atomic mass proportional to how common they are in nature.
question_patterns: calculate the average atomic mass of element X
find the average mass given isotopic abundances
determine the mean atomic mass of an element
compute the average atomic mass from isotope data
what is the average atomic mass of the element

solution_steps.action: multiply each isotope mass by its abundance fraction
solution_steps.explain: convert percentage to decimal and multiply by mass

concepts.title: Mass Percent of Elements
concepts.definition: The percentage by weight that a specific element contributes to the total molar mass of a chemical compound.
concepts.key_idea: The ratio of an element's mass to the compound's total mass expressed as a percentage.
question_patterns: calculate the mass percent of element X in compound Y
find the percentage composition of elements in Y
what is the mass percent of each element in the compound
determine the mass percent of components in Y
compute the mass percentage of elements in the given substance

solution_steps.action: calculate the total molar mass of the compound
solution_steps.explain: sum the atomic masses of all atoms in the formula
divide the element's total mass by compound mass and multiply by 100

concepts.title: Molarity of Solutions
concepts.definition: A measure of concentration defined as the number of moles of solute present in exactly one litre of the total solution.
concepts.key_idea: Concentration expressed as moles per unit volume of solution.
question_patterns: calculate the molarity of the solution
find the molar concentration of the solute
what is the molarity of X grams dissolved in Y mL
determine the molarity of the prepared solution
compute the molarity of the given mixture

solution_steps.explain: divide given mass by molar mass of the solute
divide moles by volume in litres

solution_template.explain: divide by total and multiply by 100

worked_examples.question_pattern: molarity of {mass} g of solute in {volume} mL

solution_template.explain: moles divided by volume in litres

questions: Calculate the molar mass of H2O, CO2, and CH4.
Determine the mass percent of elements in Na2SO4.
Calculate the molarity of a solution with 20g sugar in 2L.
